## Who is Hamed Mohamed?

Hamed Mohamed Abdelalim (حامد محمد عبدالعليم) is an Egyptian Full-Stack Engineer and Computer Engineering graduate based in Turkey. He has production experience building real systems used by real people — including a QR attendance platform serving 2,000+ students daily at a university, and a production multilingual restaurant platform serving ~100 daily visitors in Istanbul. He speaks Arabic (native), English, and Turkish.

## Services

- [Website and Landing Page Development](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/website-and-landing-page-development): Business websites, product pages, personal portfolios. Fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-ready.
- [Restaurant and Cafe Menu Websites](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/restaurant-menu-websites): Digital QR menus customers scan with their phone. No app download needed.
- [Full-Stack Web Development](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/full-stack-web-development): Complete applications — frontend, backend, database, deployment.
- [Node.js Backend Development](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/nodejs-backend-development): APIs, user auth, databases, real-time features. Built for reliability and speed.
- [Dashboard and Admin Panel Development](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/dashboard-and-admin-panel-development): Visual control panels for managing business data, users, and reports.
- [Bug Fixing and Debugging](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/bug-fixing-and-debugging): Fix broken websites, failing APIs, React/Node.js bugs, deployment problems.
- [Performance Optimization](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/performance-optimization): Make websites and APIs faster. Proven 98% latency reduction in production.
- [Application Security Review](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/application-security-review): Find and fix security vulnerabilities before they become problems.
- [QR Attendance Systems](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/qr-attendance-systems): Students or employees scan a QR code. Attendance recorded instantly. Admin reports auto-generated.
- [Custom Business Systems](https://www.hamedmohamed.dev/en/services/custom-business-systems): Replace spreadsheets with a system built for how your business actually works.

## Proof Points

- Kardeşler Cihangir Restaurant Platform: Production commercial site serving ~100 daily visitors, 10 languages, 6 currencies, WhatsApp ordering, WordPress migration with 25+ redirects, and full Schema.org Local SEO
- QR attendance system: 2,000+ users (~300 DAU), 6 university faculties, 98% latency reduction, 99.9% uptime
- Performance: API response time reduced from 94ms to 1.5ms (+6,100% throughput)
- Open source: 7 merged pull requests to NodeSecure security tooling
- Security: caught and fixed 15+ vulnerabilities before production
